instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/gui20_fixture_edit_seed.dxf. Change the center slot width from 12 mm to 18 mm while keeping slot length 80 mm and slot center at (90,45). Change the four corner holes from diameter 8 mm to diameter 10 mm while keeping centers (25,20), (155,20), (25,70), and (155,70). Add one new center circular hole, diameter 20 mm, centered at (90,45). Save as /home/user/Desktop/gui20_fixture_edit_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
